proposal.architecture_precedent: armv7l qemu rows, one per Python version, manylinux and musllinux.
proposal.build_backend: poetry-core with build_ext.py; one C file, no native library deps.
proposal.contribution_rules: Conventional commits, pre-commit lint; no CLA/DCO.
proposal.fork_guards: None on repository name; release is gated by ref_name==main and environment release.
proposal.rationale: The only change needed is CI matrix rows, already written upstream as open PR #153 on the maintainer's requested qemu approach; source is portable C needing no change. A second patch would duplicate it and add no value; the blocker is maintainer review (ping 2026-11-12 unanswered), not development. If PR #153 is closed or needs rework, force-develop scoped to .github/workflows/ci.yml (configuration_integration; riscv64 qemu rows for cp311-cp314 manylinux+musllinux per armv7l precedent) is the fallback. Risks: qemu build time, build_ext.py swallowing compile errors (assert .so), and the stalled review.
proposal.release_coverage: PyPI 2.0.3: win32/amd64, macOS arm64, manylinux/musllinux x86_64+aarch64 (+armv7l cp311-13); no riscv64.
proposal.release_graph: ci.yml: test/lint/commitlint -> release (main, PSR) -> build_wheels (cibuildwheel v4.2.0) -> upload_pypi (OIDC).

ci_history.findings: Upstream release path is one workflow in the same repo; wheels use cibuildwheel with CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX for qemu rows. Precedent row to follow is armv7l (qemu, one runner per Python version, manylinux+musllinux). The sdist-only fallback and pure-Python fnvhash fallback exist, so riscv64 users get a working package today. Note build_ext.py swallows extension build errors, meaning a qemu riscv64 build could silently produce a pure-Python wheel unless REQUIRE_EXTENSION is checked.

sources.finding: Release graph: test/lint/commitlint -> release (main only, PSR + trusted publishing) -> build_wheels (needs release.outputs.released==true) -> upload_pypi (OIDC, environment release). No fork guard on repository name; release job is gated on ref_name==main and environment release.
PR 153 CI: tests, release-dry-run succeeded; build_wheels/release/upload_pypi skipped on PRs, so riscv64 wheel build is not exercised until a real release.
v2.0.3 ships win32, win_amd64, macosx arm64, manylinux x86_64/aarch64/armv7l, musllinux x86_64/aarch64/armv7l (cp311-cp313; cp314/cp314t lack armv7l), sdist; no riscv64.

RISE builds cp312-cp314/314t riscv64 manylinux wheels with cibuildwheel, asserting the .so imports and running pytest; REQUIRE_EXTENSION alone is not enough since build_ext.py swallows compile errors.

data.summary: fnv-hash-fast 2.0.3 (single-file portable C extension, poetry-core backend, pure-Python fnvhash fallback) ships no riscv64 wheel on PyPI. RISE already builds riscv64 wheels in python-wheels (#1114). The upstream change already exists as open PR Bluetooth-Devices/fnv-hash-fast#153 (qemu rows modelled on armv7l, adapted per maintainer bdraco's request), awaiting maintainer review. No further patch is needed, so recommend park.
